name: issue-342051-how-to-verify
title: How to verify #342051 · Open links from Quick Open · Insiders from Oct 17 or newer

setup.label: SET UP
setup.do: Serve any folder (a 404 page is fine): `python3 -m http.server 8642 --bind 127.0.0.1`. Open `README.md`.

open.label: STEP 1 OF 4
open.do: ⌘P (Ctrl+P), paste a file link to a line, e.g. `file:///…/src/greet.ts#L3`, then Enter.
open.look: Placeholder: “…or paste a link”; an Open Link row. `greet.ts` opens here, on line 3.

side.label: STEP 2 OF 4
side.do: In `README.md`: ⌘P, paste the same link, ⌥Enter (Alt+Enter on Windows/Linux).
side.look: `greet.ts` opens beside it, on line 3; `README.md` stays visible.

handlers.label: STEP 3 OF 4
handlers.do: From `README.md`: ⌘P, paste `http://127.0.0.1:8642/review.html?pr=342081#changes`, click the side button.
handlers.look: With `workbench.browser.openLocalhostLinks` on, it opens in the integrated browser beside `README.md`.
